title: Evaluating Heart & Soil's Lifeblood on Iron and Energy Levels
official: Evaluating Heart & Soil's Lifeblood on Iron and Energy Levels
summary: This study explores how Heart \& Soil's Lifeblood impacts iron levels and energy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Can read and understand English.
* US resident.
* Willing and able to follow the requirements of the protocol.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individuals with Hemochromatosis
* Individuals with Severe Allergies
* Pregnant or Nursing Women
* Individuals with Gastrointestinal Disorders
* Individuals on Iron-Related Medications
* Individuals with Mental Health Disorders
* Competitive Athletes
